description: Build end-to-end scenario script: (1) seed a test MCP server in mcp_server_registry, (2) run signal_analyser to score it across all 8 signals including the 3 new enrichments (supply_chain_enrichment, community_signal_enrichment, permission_scope_enrichment_v2, temporal_stability_enrichment_v2, tool_description_safety_enrichment_v2), (3) verify trust_synthesiser produces a valid 6-tier verdict, (4) verify attestation_engine writes attestation, (5) verify UI_api surface shows verdict. Use synthetic metadata dicts for enrichment testing. NOT the same as e2e_scenarios.py which is quarantined - this is a focused signal flow test.
